hops.note: Created in cmd/seedling/export.go from the CSV export that was the body of main(), with -from and -weeks on the export subcommand's own flag set.
Reads the roster from a new -data flag, fills in each day's volunteer with schedule.Assign(), defaults -weeks to 1, and drops the notes column.
Added to parse -from and -weeks and print each watering day as a CSV row with empty volunteer and notes columns.
Added a day column holding the weekday name.
Its export code moved out to export(), and main now dispatches the export and serve subcommands and prints usage otherwise.
Dispatches the new remind subcommand.
Dispatches the new sheet subcommand.
Added to give each day to the available volunteer with the fewest shifts so far, ties to roster order, leaving the day blank when nobody can take it.
Now skips anyone who watered the day before.
Added to list every day except Sunday in the given number of weeks.
Added to look up tomorrow's volunteer in shifts.csv and the roster and text them through Twilio.
The text now ends with a signed swap link instead of a thank-you.
Sends the reminder and swap link as a Gmail SMTP email instead of a Twilio text, and skips volunteers with no email.
Added the GET and POST /swap handlers, which check the signed token, show the roster, and reassign the shift to someone on it.
Refuses a taker who already waters the day before or after, through nextTo().
Added in internal/notify/sms.go as a Twilio REST sender with a Send(to, body) method.
Deleted with internal/notify/sms.go when reminders moved to email.
Added to main() with default 4 as the number of weeks of watering days to export.
Moved to the export subcommand's flag set in export.go with the same default.
Default changed from 4 to 1, the help text now says weeks to schedule, and the days now go through schedule.Assign().
Added to main() as the first day of the sheet, parsed as YYYY-MM-DD.
Moved to the export subcommand's flag set in export.go.
Help text changed from first day of the sheet to first day to schedule.
Added as the usage text listing the export and serve commands.
export is now described as making the weekly schedule as CSV.
Lists the new remind command as texting tomorrow's volunteer.
serve is now described as running the sign-up website and swap pages.
remind is now described as emailing, and the new sheet command is listed.
Added a cron line that runs seedling remind at 6pm on the garden server.
The reminder now runs at 5pm instead of 6pm.
Added the sign-up form, whose thank-you line misspells garden as gardne.
Spelling-only fix of gardne to garden in the thank-you line.
The phone label now asks for a cell phone for evening-before texts.
Phone became optional and the email label says reminders come by email.
